question.text: In the Saianand Commercial Limited case, the directors were penalized under which section of SCRA?

explanation.text: The Logic: In the Saianand Commercial Limited matter, the directors were penalized under Section 23A(a) of SCRA, with monetary penalties of Rs 2 lakhs each, for failure to make required corporate disclosures. The Trap: Section 23E deals with listing-condition breaches more broadly, but the specific charge against the Saianand directors was under Section 23A(a). Note: Tie the Saianand case to Section 23A(a) and Rs 2 lakhs penalty per director.
